title: Rotation and climb-out
summary: Rotate at VR, hold V2 + 10 on the climb, gear up with a positive rate, and away to 3,000 ft.
briefing: Today she flies. The bugs on the airspeed show V1, VR and V2: rotate at VR.
Rotate smoothly toward ten degrees, no further: the tail is close to the runway. Then hold V2 plus ten with the pitch to a thousand feet, and gear up as soon as the climb is positive.

tasks.say: Takeoff thrust: levers all the way up.
tasks.done: Thrust set. Eyes on the speed.

tasks.goal: Rotate at VR and lift off.
tasks.say: At VR, ease back on the stick: the down arrow, or pull on the yoke. Smoothly, toward ten degrees.

cues.say: Easy: not so far, or the tail touches.

tasks.goal: Climb to 3,000 ft at V2 + 10, gear up.
tasks.say: Positive climb: gear up, G. Hold V2 plus ten with the pitch to a thousand feet: nose up if you're fast, down if you're slow. Then lower the nose a little and let her accelerate.
tasks.done: Three thousand feet and clean. Nicely done.

cues.say: We're fast: raise the nose a little.
Too steep: lower the nose, keep the speed.

debrief.three: A textbook climb: the speed nailed to the bug the whole way.
debrief.two: A safe climb-out. Chase the speed a little less: small pitch changes, then wait.
debrief.one: Up and away. The speed wandered: pitch for the speed, and give it time to settle.
debrief.failed: That takeoff didn't go to plan. Rotate at VR, gently, toward ten degrees. Again?
